ns3.observable: Table2 mean FCT(ms), end-to-end delay/RTT(ms), mean per-flow throughput(Mbps) for 2/4-cluster default and Unison; Section6.2 thread determinism.

reference.interpretation: Published values are averages. Event tie-breaking legitimately differs between Unison and default. Test repeated Unison thread counts for exact determinism; do not demand equal packets versus default as a paper claim.

ns3.inputs: First diagnostic reduced 0.1s; full accuracy scenario uses cluster2/4, k4, delay500000ns, bandwidth100Mbps, buffer100p, NewReno, packet500, load0.7, time5s, flowmon enabled, default author seed.
ns3.tolerance: Table2 printed precision: absolute difference <=0.005 in the printed unit for each two-decimal table entry (rounding agreement only, not a scientific equivalence margin). Unison determinism: exact equality of printed event counts and model metrics across repeated runs/threads.
ns3.scope: Attempt exact author accuracy settings and compare with Table2; differences retained as failed match. Hardware speedup not tested; reduced diagnostic separate from paper input.
ns3.tolerance_basis: Paper Table2 prints two decimals; half the last printed decimal unit. Section6.2 explicitly claims exact Unison event-count/results agreement across1..16threads. Earlier proposed1%/packet equality rule superseded BEFORE output after reading actual article.

simgrid.observable: Coordinator-worker simulated makespan across matched authored C++ model at SimGrid3.36 and4.0; one physical core wall time/RSS recorded for paper-family workload.
simgrid.reference: SimGrid3.36 author benchmark, compared with same source compiled against4.0. Paper Section7 Figures13–14 gives workload family, but exact v3/v4 source pair unresolved.
simgrid.inputs: Initial bounded 4 hosts,4 cores/host,100-200Mflop/s,100 links,100-200MB/s,route length10,40tasks,100Mflop/100MB per task,seeds0..2. Then 1000hosts4cores and4000workunits where reasonable.
simgrid.tolerance: Absolute makespan difference <=1e-6 simulated seconds for same generated inputs and seed. Exploratory version-equivalence rule, not published tolerance.
simgrid.scope: A current source-version comparison cannot establish the historical figures or their hardware-specific speedups.

simgrid_paper_pair.observable: Compare original MSG3.10 and S4U3.36 author benchmark makespans and simulator RSS/wall time for paper Figure13 workload, 1000hosts4cores,4000tasks; exploratory diagnostic4hosts40tasks first.
simgrid_paper_pair.reference: Paper introduction explicitly calls3.10 v3, with developments through3.36 culminating in4.0; reference66 Dockerfiles pin3.10 and3.36.
simgrid_paper_pair.tolerance: Makespan agreement <=1e-6 simulated seconds (local validation rule, not specified by paper); report observed differences and performance ratios without asserting hardware-specific speedup replication.
simgrid_paper_pair.tolerance_basis: Six decimals in native log timestamps. No portable runtime/RSS threshold imposed.
simgrid_paper_pair.repetitions: Three seeds for bounded matched validation; 10 seeds if completing paper4000task anchor is feasible. Full4000..60000workunit sweep still separate.
